title: EchoLens, an accessibility hub
description:
An accessibility assistant built for a TSA competition, with a vision side and a hearing side.
Vision Assistance watches the camera, recognizes objects in real time and reads out what it sees. Hearing Assistance gives live speech-to-text captions with translation into other languages, an ambient gain boost, and an export of the conversation as a report. Every button is narrated on hover, so the whole app can be used without seeing the screen.
howItWorks: A Flask app serves the interface. Object detection runs YOLOv8 through Ultralytics on OpenCV camera frames, speech is spoken with pyttsx3, and translation goes through deep-translator.
